findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head 3bf00fec9dc6944d3da980e0ae938b65eb12a12b, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The base implementation compared userTenant with documentTenant, so the PR continues to bypass tenant ownership checks.
